# Graphs

Every built-in graph. *Exposed parameters* are the names a parameter set gives in `[params]` (a project) or `[defaults]` (a preset); each sets the node parameters it points to (`node.parameter`, types in [nodes.md](nodes.md)). A node of type `graph:<id>` is a subgraph. Diagrams: `automapgen show <id>` or docsHuman/graphs/<id>.md.

## biomes

Biomes 1-4 of the game and the mountain mask from the heights: effective height = height + extra height on steep slopes + smooth noise (irregular borders), cut into height bands and majority-filtered.

Inputs: `heights: field`  
Outputs: `biomes: classes`, `mountains: mask`

Exposed parameters:

- `work_scale` -> `coarse.work_scale`: computed at 1/work_scale of the heightmap resolution
- `steep_from_deg` -> `steep_bonus.start`: slopes steeper than this count as higher
- `steep_m_per_deg` -> `steep_bonus.per_unit`: extra height per degree above steep_from_deg (m)
- `boundary_noise_m` -> `border_noise.amplitude`: irregular borders: +- metres
- `seed` -> `border_noise.seed`: random seed of the border noise
- `smooth_m` -> `majority.radius_m`, `mountains.radius_m`: majority filter radius (m)
- `limits_m` -> `bands.limits`: borders between biome 1|2, 2|3, 3|4 (effective height, m)
- `mountains_from_m` -> `above_mountain_line.limit`: mountain mask from this effective height (m)

Nodes:

- `coarse` [field.resample](nodes.md#fieldresample)
- `slope` [field.slope](nodes.md#fieldslope)
- `steep_bonus` [field.ramp](nodes.md#fieldramp): steep slopes move up a band
- `border_noise` [field.noise](nodes.md#fieldnoise)
- `effective` [field.sum](nodes.md#fieldsum): height + steep bonus + noise
- `bands` [classes.bands](nodes.md#classesbands)
- `majority` [classes.majority](nodes.md#classesmajority)
- `above_mountain_line` [mask.above](nodes.md#maskabove)
- `mountains` [mask.smooth](nodes.md#masksmooth)

## climate_mod

The climate mod of a landscape for one reference height and map scale: the base climate's original files, the material and import trees made from the climate preset, the climate definition and generators, the climate tile, the own economy, waterfall brushes and Classic Trees (each optional), and the package with mod hub texts, translations and thumbnail.

Inputs: `reference_m: number`, `map_format: map_format`  
Outputs: `mod: mod_files`, `mod_id: text`, `waterfall_preview: image`

Exposed parameters:

- `climate` -> `originals.climate`, `identity.climate`, `material.climate`, `imports.climate`, `definition.climate`, `texts.climate`, `classic_trees.climate`: preset: the climate (landscape type)
- `transition` -> `identity.transition`, `material.transition`, `imports.transition`, `definition.transition`, `texts.transition`: landscape: a second look on part of the map
- `publishing` -> `identity.publishing`, `pictures.publishing`, `texts.publishing`, `package.publishing`: names, author and images of the published mods
- `climate_texts` -> `identity.climate_texts`, `pictures.climate_texts`, `texts.climate_texts`: texts and picture of the climate mod
- `economy` -> `economy.economy`, `texts.economy`: economy of the climate
- `industries` -> `economy.industries`: preset: the industry planning (industries and cargos of other climates)
- `waterfall` -> `waterfall.waterfall`: waterfall brushes of the climate mod

## map

**Map Generation**

The complete map: heightmap, biomes and rivers (painted ones moved into the valley line); a draft terrain (terrain_core) for the planners - paths, country roads, towns, industries; the terrain settled around towns and industries; the final terrain (terrain_core again) with the terrain under roads and paths and the riverbed groove; all import layers, plans, the map editor's import files, the climate mod and the map's own mods (paths as streets, industry names). The road network between the places is not built here (experimental, graph map_roads).

Exposed parameters:

- `dem_path` -> `source_data.dem_path`: GeoTIFF of the elevation model (empty: download)
- `crop` -> `source_data.crop`: part of the elevation model (WGS84 degrees)
- `dem_download` -> `source_data.dem_download`: without dem_path: the elevation model to download from OpenTopography
- `game_width_km` -> `source_data.game_width_km`
- `game_height_km` -> `source_data.game_height_km`
- `scale` -> `source_data.scale`: scale 1:scale
- `height_scale` -> `source_data.height_scale`: heights 1:height_scale; empty = like the distances
- `rotation_deg` -> `source_data.rotation_deg`
- `min_height_m` -> `terraforming.min_height_m`: lowest land; empty = lowest point
- `water_sink_m` -> `terraforming.water_sink_m`, `final_terrain.water_sink_m`: core of real water this much below the lowest land
- `max_height_m` -> `final_terrain.max_height_m`: white of the heightmap; empty = highest point
- `real_water_rivers` -> `terraforming.real_water_rivers`: which waterways may be real water: all (below the limit) or only navigable ones (CEMT class, navigable_names, unnamed canals attached to them)
- `navigable_names` -> `terraforming.navigable_names`: waterways whose name starts with one of these count as navigable (case-insensitive)
- `ramp_length_game_m` -> `terraforming.ramp_length_game_m`, `final_terrain.ramp_length_game_m`: ramp of the painted riverbed down to real water over this length (game m); 0 = no ramp
- `ramp_corridor_game_m` -> `terraforming.ramp_corridor_game_m`, `final_terrain.ramp_corridor_game_m`: the terrain beside the ramp follows it this far on each side (game m)
- `real_water_until_m` -> `terraforming.real_water_until_m`, `final_terrain.real_water_until_m`: real (game) water only up to this height a.s.l.; above painted water; empty = 120 m above the lowest land
- `climate_reference_step_m` -> `climate.climate_reference_step_m`: the climate mod's reference height = the lowest land rounded to this step (0 = exact)
- `max_towns` -> `planning.max_towns`: at most this many towns (0 = from the map area)
- `ignore_town_size` -> `planning.ignore_town_size`: ignore the real town size: all towns start at the minimum and count as equal (industries, roads)
- `industry_density` -> `planning.industry_density`: industry density: factories per type, raw-material industries and resource areas x this factor
- `all_cargos` -> `planning.all_cargos`: all cargos: resources without fitting land get areas anyway (unrealistic); factories without input source are placed anyway
- `town_min_distance_game_m` -> `planning.town_min_distance_game_m`: minimum distance between towns
- `path_forest_gap_game_m` -> `biome_creation.path_forest_gap_game_m`: gap in the forest along paths
- `road_forest_gap_game_m` -> `biome_creation.road_forest_gap_game_m`: gap in the forest along roads
- `forest_shrink_px` -> `biome_creation.forest_shrink_px`: shrink the forest along its edge (1 px = 4 game m; 0 = off) against the game's coarse layer reading
- `biome_limits_m` -> `terraforming.biome_limits_m`: preset: borders between biome 1|2, 2|3, 3|4 (m)
- `mountains_from_m` -> `terraforming.mountains_from_m`: preset: mountain mask from (m)
- `forest_classes` -> `terraforming.forest_classes`, `final_terrain.forest_classes`: preset
- `meadow_classes` -> `terraforming.meadow_classes`, `final_terrain.meadow_classes`: preset
- `cropland_classes` -> `terraforming.cropland_classes`, `final_terrain.cropland_classes`: preset

## map_biome_creation

**Biome Creation**

The masks of the game's import dialog, on the heightmap grid: the biome map (grey 0/63/127/191/255) and the mountain mask; forest (WorldCover trees, minus water, banks, riverbed, fields, gaps along paths and roads and a strip along its edge), meadow, cropland (OpenStreetMap fields), rock, glacier, painted water, shore, riverbed, the crop layers (corn, wheat, soil) and the transition mask; land cover and crop previews.

## map_climate

## map_final_terrain

**Final Terrain**

The terrain that is written: evened out around towns (tilted plane) and industries (level), the terrain chain again on the settled heights (water, banks, layers), painted riverbeds ramped down into real water, country roads and paths worked into the terrain (level across, smoothed grade-limited profile, cut and fill), the riverbed groove, and the 16-bit heightmap with its height references.

Inputs: `land: field`, `worldcover_water: mask`, `land_min_m: number`, `map_format: map_format`, `towns: town_list`, `industries: industry_list`, `landcover: classes`, `river_plan: river_plan`, `farmland: osm_areas`, `roads: road_lines`, `paths: path_plan`, `black_m: number`

- `ramp_length_game_m` -> `ramp.length_game_m`: ramp of the painted riverbed down to real water over this length (game m); 0 = no ramp
- `ramp_corridor_game_m` -> `ramp.corridor_game_m`: the terrain beside the ramp follows it this far on each side (game m)
- `real_water_until_m` -> `final.real_water_until_m`: real (game) water only up to this height a.s.l.; above painted water

## map_planning

**Planning**

Planned on the draft terrain: field tracks, hiking paths and country roads from OpenStreetMap, towns at OpenStreetMap places with a population on buildable land, and industries on suitable resource areas near the towns. Writes the map editor's import files and previews.

Inputs: `draft_planning_landcover: classes`, `osm_paths: osm_lines`, `places: osm_points`, `frame: map_frame`, `draft_water: mask`, `draft_glacier: mask`, `osm_roads: osm_lines`, `biome_preview: image`, `draft_heightmap: image`, `draft_heights: field`, `black_m: number`, `draft_shore: mask`, `draft_rock: mask`, `map_format: map_format`, `draft_forest: mask`, `draft_meadow: mask`, `draft_cropland: mask`, `mountains: mask`, `industry_rules: industry_rules`

Exposed parameters:

- `max_towns` -> `towns.max_towns`: at most this many towns (0 = from the map area)
- `ignore_town_size` -> `towns.ignore_town_size`, `industries.ignore_town_size`: ignore the real town size: all towns start at the minimum and count as equal (industries, roads)
- `industry_density` -> `industries.industry_density`: industry density: factories per type, raw-material industries and resource areas x this factor
- `all_cargos` -> `industries.all_cargos`: all cargos: resources without fitting land get areas anyway (unrealistic); factories without input source are placed anyway
- `town_min_distance_game_m` -> `towns.town_min_distance_game_m`: minimum distance between towns
- `industries` -> `industries.industries`: preset: the industry planning of the climate

## map_planning_industries

**Industries**

Building sites and resource areas in the draft terrain as the game will see it (forest, rock, flat land ...); raw-material industries in the resource areas, processing industries near medium and large towns by the game's production rules, demand per town, names after the nearest place. Writes the towns and industries import files.

Inputs: `draft_heights: field`, `draft_heightmap: image`, `black_m: number`, `map_format: map_format`, `draft_forest: mask`, `draft_meadow: mask`, `draft_cropland: mask`, `draft_rock: mask`, `draft_glacier: mask`, `draft_water: mask`, `draft_shore: mask`, `mountains: mask`, `towns: town_list`, `industry_rules: industry_rules`, `places: osm_points`, `frame: map_frame`  
Outputs: `industries: industry_list`

Exposed parameters:

- `industries` -> `industry_areas.industries`, `industry_plan.industries`: preset: the industry planning of the climate
- `ignore_town_size` -> `industry_plan.ignore_town_size`: all towns equal: each is medium and gets a long-distance cargo
- `industry_density` -> `industry_areas.industry_density`, `industry_plan.industry_density`: industry density: factories per type, raw-material industries and resource areas x this factor
- `all_cargos` -> `industry_areas.all_cargos`, `industry_plan.all_cargos`: all cargos: resources without fitting land get areas anyway (unrealistic); factories without input source are placed anyway

Nodes:

- `industry_areas` [industries.resource_areas](nodes.md#industriesresource_areas)

- `industries_lua` [file.text](nodes.md#filetext)
- `industries_towns_lua` [file.text](nodes.md#filetext): towns with their demand only - the industries are placed by hand

## map_source_data

**Source Data**

Everything read from outside, laid onto the map: the game map's size and scale (map format), the elevation model (a GeoTIFF or a download from OpenTopography) cropped, rotated and resampled to the heightmap grid (the map frame; once more without levelling for the rivers), ESA WorldCover land cover (10 m, most frequent class per pixel), from OpenStreetMap the waterways, fields, places, paths and country roads touching the map, and the production rules of the game's industries.

Inputs: -  
Outputs: `heights: field`, `landcover: classes`, `original_heights: field`, `waterways: osm_ways`, `frame: map_frame`, `farmland: osm_areas`, `map_format: map_format`, `osm_paths: osm_lines`, `places: osm_points`, `osm_roads: osm_lines`, `industry_rules: industry_rules`

Exposed parameters:

- `dem_path` -> `dem.path`, `original.path`: GeoTIFF of the elevation model (empty: download)
- `crop` -> `dem.crop`, `original.crop`: part of the elevation model (WGS84 degrees)
- `dem_download` -> `dem.download`, `original.download`: without dem_path: the elevation model to download from OpenTopography
- `game_width_km` -> `format.game_width_km`
- `game_height_km` -> `format.game_height_km`
- `scale` -> `format.scale`: scale 1:scale
- `height_scale` -> `format.height_scale`: heights 1:height_scale; empty = like the distances
- `rotation_deg` -> `on_map.rotation_deg`, `original.rotation_deg`

## map_terraforming

**Terraforming**

The first, draft terrain the planners work on: height references (lowest land = game height 0, bottom of real water), biomes 1-4 and the mountain mask from the heights, the rivers from OpenStreetMap split into real water (only in the lowest valleys) and painted water, and the draft terrain with shaped water, banks and layers.

Inputs: `heights: field`, `landcover: classes`, `original_heights: field`, `waterways: osm_ways`, `frame: map_frame`, `farmland: osm_areas`, `map_format: map_format`  
Outputs: `biomes: classes`, `mountains: mask`, `draft_planning_landcover: classes`, `draft_water: mask`, `draft_glacier: mask`, `biome_preview: image`, `draft_heightmap: image`, `draft_heights: field`, `black_m: number`, `draft_shore: mask`, `draft_rock: mask`, `draft_forest: mask`, `draft_meadow: mask`, `draft_cropland: mask`, `land: field`, `worldcover_water: mask`, `land_min_m: number`, `river_plan: river_plan`

Exposed parameters:

- `min_height_m` -> `elevation.min_height_m`: lowest land; empty = lowest point
- `water_sink_m` -> `elevation.water_sink_m`, `draft_terrain.water_sink_m`: core of real water this much below the lowest land
- `real_water_rivers` -> `rivers_and_water.real_water_rivers`: which waterways may be real water: all (below the limit) or only navigable ones (CEMT class, navigable_names, unnamed canals attached to them)
- `navigable_names` -> `rivers_and_water.navigable_names`: waterways whose name starts with one of these count as navigable (case-insensitive)
- `ramp_length_game_m` -> `draft_terrain.ramp_length_game_m`: ramp of the painted riverbed down to real water over this length (game m); 0 = no ramp
- `ramp_corridor_game_m` -> `draft_terrain.ramp_corridor_game_m`: the terrain beside the ramp follows it this far on each side (game m)
- `real_water_until_m` -> `rivers_and_water.real_water_until_m`, `draft_terrain.real_water_until_m`: real (game) water only up to this height a.s.l.; above painted water
- `biome_limits_m` -> `biomes.biome_limits_m`: preset: borders between biome 1|2, 2|3, 3|4 (m)
- `mountains_from_m` -> `biomes.mountains_from_m`: preset: mountain mask from (m)
- `forest_classes` -> `draft_terrain.forest_classes`: preset
- `meadow_classes` -> `draft_terrain.meadow_classes`: preset
- `cropland_classes` -> `draft_terrain.cropland_classes`: preset
- `rock_classes` -> `draft_terrain.rock_classes`: preset
- `crops` -> `draft_terrain.crops`: preset: crop types of the fields

- `elevation` [graph:map_terraforming_elevation](#map_terraforming_elevation)
- `biomes` [graph:map_terraforming_biomes](#map_terraforming_biomes)
- `rivers_and_water` [graph:map_terraforming_rivers](#map_terraforming_rivers)
